reviews.review: EA-play / Origin etc ; just adding unnecessary headaches and things to debug when you want to play this game.

Andromeda got a lot of pounding back in the days due to its release state. Bugs and performance issues are now solved for the most part. 

That being said, the game is not very good. It has its moments. If you play only the main quests and the missions for each of your squad mates for sure would be a better game. Sadly this game is ginormous and suffers for it. The side content isn't bad per se but it smothers the main story with fillers.
The main story, flimsy as it is, is copied beat for beat from the original trilogy. I mean soldier-type guy who is privy to information about an upcoming galaxy-wide threat has to do quests for different species to convince them to band together in an Avengers Endgame type finale while simultaneously pursuing technologies left behind by an ancient, now extinct race, because he is the only one who can interact with them and which somehow would help against the threat. 
Am I talking about the original trilogy or andromeda? 

The game is so lazy, as attention has been put in in some regards and improvements have been made in the gameplay area and visual area just enough so it could justify its existence. This theory is further supported by the fact that we basically have the same party of aliens from the original trilogy. We traveled for 600 years to another galaxy and instead of meeting new and exotic races with their own new looks and cultures, we only get 1 new alien. Plus the enemies but its never established that they even are from Andromeda. And we never learn anything about them, they are incredibly generic. We never get to see their cities, or to talk to them about anything. 
The story is so uninspired and it stinks of obligatory sequel that was made just to ride the cash wave that would be instantly generated by using a well established franchise without actually having anything to do with it. 
It's exactly a 72 metascore game. I can't in good conscience recommend it but some fun is to be had with it depending on your approach to the side content.

I was initially very skeptical of this game, I am usually one for originality. Not so much for sequels using different a different character.  In comparing this game, Andromeda to the M1,M2,M3 this game surpases them in every way when it comes to graphics and the beauty of the worlds and space. 

I am only about 75 hours in on this game compared to the 100 hours for the first 3 ME games. That's 75 hours of play time JUST with the story and maybe a dozen side quests. There is so much left to be done.  Not sure if it'll ever get completed, there's that much. The multiplayer feature is pretty cool and adds to the amount of content, if you're into pvp/team style shooters. 

I'd say this game is worth the money, granted, I received it as a gift, but price wise, the amount of playtime and content is more then enough to cover price.  I thoroughly enjoyed the game and would recommend completely if you enjoy space themed games. A new take on the classic ME games wins this review with two thumbs up and my big toes if I could!
